examples.title: A B-spline transform applied by ANTs and larmorx
examples.summary: The B-spline transform ANTs 2.6.5 found for ds000005 sub-01's T1w (sMRIPrep's template registration with BSpline[0.1,104] for its SyN stage, on every third voxel; a knot spacing of 104 mm, because with antsRegistrationSyN.sh's 26 mm ANTs had not finished after almost four hours), applied with the registration's affine (its composite, as antsRegistration writes it with sMRIPrep's options) to the 1 mm T1w onto the 2 mm template, Lanczos, as fMRIPrep resamples the T1w into MNI space; given to ANTs 2.6.5 and to larmorx, in single and double precision. Before A5 part 3 larmorx refused B-spline transform files.
